findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a deferred idea is waiting when someone starts a fix with `forge start` and follows the suggested `forge land` command.
`forge start` commits the waiting `plans/ideas.md` to the fix (`src/forge/intake.py:153-164`). `unbuilt_fix` treats that commit as completed work (`src/forge/task.py:769-775`), so land skips the worker (`src/forge/land.py:91-103`). This change now also lets the idea file pass `require_fix_changes`; close then classifies it as bookkeeping and skips review (`src/forge/close.py:298-301,354-361`). The fix can be marked Ready, or automatically merged, without its requested work ever being done. Unlike the settled lost-change case, this failure starts no worker and requires no merge that discards work.
Adds work: exclude carried ideas from completed fix work; F 2 x H 3 = 6; 2 x C = 2.
findings.title: A carried idea lets forge land skip building the next fix

why: A fix that changes a forge.toml test setting (other than merge) loses that change before close, and close still reports the pull request ready with no real change.
